sources.role_in_batch: Companion of the target proof package; no complete appendix is claimed as formalized by this batch.

covered: Pointwise probability error in an adequate finite prime cylinder, with the actual defective-vertex count.
Exact uniform word probability for every fixed assignment of the small prime coordinates.
remaining: Explicit transfer of the word event and conditional formulation to the infinite source model.
Uniform summed first-moment estimate over masks and dictionaries in a fixed logarithmic band.

covered: Abstract nullity comparison after imposing a linear map into a two-dimensional binary space.
Factor-four relation-weight comparison and finite sum with a nonzero-host correction.
remaining: Actual two-window valuation matrix and block-parity instantiation.
Identification with relative-sign start relations by the tree-boundary bijection.
Identification of the ordered separated-pair sum and unrestricted square-relation hosts.
Uniform arithmetic host and relation estimates needed for the asymptotic conclusion.

additional_exclusions: The complete signed marked-field, dictionary, and two-source crossover theorems.
